incidents.name: Migrator accepted an attacker-supplied Comptroller
incidents.notes: Migrator.migrateAllPositions() took the source Mendi Comptroller as an unvalidated caller-supplied address, so the attacker passed a fake Comptroller and fake cToken markets deployed in the same transaction and had Malda credit real positions against fabricated balances.

sources.ref: onchain review on Linea: the Migrator 0xa0dc62A8eE34bcd7c9a08852C980Ed78E0Cf99c0 was created 2025-05-29 by 0xb819a871d20913839c37f316dc914b0570bfc0ee (Malda deployer), 34.8 hours before the attack tx sent by 0x370a8db1f020ce70e8eab2502c739844ca2c2910; the attack tx is itself a contract-creation deploying the exploit contract 0xb1e2c543035dc0ca845f91aec68f8a891ea5d74f and the fake Comptroller
